mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inspection_item (batch_id, light_group_id, group_code, installation_location, power, zone_id, zone_name, inspect_result, site_description, recorded_at) VALUES (#{item.batchId}, #{item.lightGroupId}, #{item.groupCode}, #{item.installationLocation}, #{item.power}, #{item.zoneId}, #{item.zoneName}, #{item.inspectResult}, #{item.siteDescription}, #{item.recordedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inspect_result = CASE WHEN (SELECT b.status FROM inspection_batch b WHERE b.id = #{item.batchId}) = 0 THEN VALUES(inspect_result) ELSE inspect_result END, site_description = CASE WHEN (SELECT b.status FROM inspection_batch b WHERE b.id = #{item.batchId}) = 0 THEN VALUES(site_description) ELSE site_description END, recorded_at = CASE WHEN (SELECT b.status FROM inspection_batch b WHERE b.id = #{item.batchId}) = 0 THEN VALUES(recorded_at) ELSE recorded_at END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspection_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND inspect_result IS NOT NULL
